title: Fresh hand: premium, playful, GDG-native, developer-literate
question: Steered by your answer (all four qualities). New grounded directions from the GDG developer world; the roll leads with the Developer Console.

options.label: Developer Console
options.lineage: premium developer tools and terminals (Cloud Shell, modern terminals, command palettes)
options.thesis: Every code is a command: its payload is stdout and the scan advisor is a linter, inside a beautifully made console.
materials: dark console panes on a light page
confident grotesk display with a precise mono
options.viewport: Light page; the headline large at left; at right a console pane where `qr encode wifi --ssid GDG-Campus` types itself, stdout prints the escaped payload and the live QR renders under the prompt; Open Studio as the primary button with its shortcut.
options.risk: Collapses into the dark-terminal-with-neon cliché if the page goes dark too; the console must show real engine output, not decoration.

raised.raise: Sections progress like a skill sheet, from the simplest payload (Text) to the hardest (escaped Wi-Fi).
Absence is designed: empty, invalid and loading states show ghost modules, never a blank box.
Modules wake in sequence like timed fountains: one choreographed reveal on load.
The active control lights from inside; inactive steps fold back to outlines.

options.label: GDG Keycap Set
options.lineage: custom mechanical keyboards and keycap sets
options.thesis: Types, presets and actions are keycaps in GDG blue, red, yellow and green that press with real travel.
options.viewport: A keyboard plate across the hero: five keycaps labelled URL, TEXT, EMAIL, PHONE, WI-FI; pressing one re-encodes the live code mounted above like a display.
options.risk: Tactile 3D keys are a look many product sites use; becomes a gimmick if keycaps spread past controls.

options.label: Friendly App Surface
options.thesis: A friendly consumer app: soft cards, plain-language labels, and GDG blue only where something can be done.
options.viewport: One friendly column: the headline over a single card with the type picker and a big live code; a bottom bar with Download.
options.case: Wins audience through Google-app familiarity for students; loses clarity because it cannot dramatise payloads or the advisor.
options.risk: Closest to the category canon; generic the moment the craft slips.

options.label: Live Code Stage
options.thesis: Edit the payload line and the projected code re-renders on the next beat.
options.viewport: A black stage: one giant payload line with a blinking cursor, the QR projected beside it, the next change flashing amber.
options.case: Wins audience with real student and developer energy; ties the console on clarity but is darker and louder.
options.risk: Lives in the neon-on-black default; hard to make premium or accessible.

options.label: Stitched Sampler
options.thesis: Bands of increasing difficulty, signed at the foot.
options.case: No link to students making posters or to scanning.
options.kept: Sections ordered as a learning progression.

options.label: Seven-segment Display
options.thesis: Every number lit in one segment mask.
options.viewport: Contrast ratio glowing as red digits.
options.case: Shows numbers, not encoding; weak audience fit.
options.kept: Absence is designed as deliberately as light.

options.label: Garden Vistas
options.thesis: Axial vistas and fountains waking in sequence.
options.case: Nothing to do with the audience or the product.
options.kept: One choreographed sequence instead of scattered motion.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.thesis: Paper volumes glowing from one bulb.
options.viewport: Glowing paper moons in a dim room.
options.case: Soft glow undermines a contrast-led product.
options.kept: The active element lights from inside.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS-style generator landing page, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA on the left, a framed screenshot of the studio on the right, then a feature grid and FAQ.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other QR generator by design.
